facets.description: Catch block (lines 189-197) increments retryCount for transient/unrelated errors (DB, parse, profile lookup), so reminders are deleted after 2 strikes
Else branch (lines 178-187) increments retryCount when scheduleSMS returns falsy for locked/rate-limited accounts, deleting reminders that should wait for the lock to clear
A failed DB update after Twilio scheduling succeeds still increments retryCount, which leaves an orphaned SMS that can't be cancelled and gets scheduled twice
deleteMany OR branch (lines 38-42) has no method:SMS or scheduled:false scope
